text: Pimple extraction takes 4 minutes + AHA application for 2 minutes, followed by 1 minute of saline solution cleansing, 10 seconds of moisturizer application, and 10 seconds of sunscreen application. Including sitting/wiping, the total time is less than 10 minutes. The price is 200 baht. The shop calls this a "treatment." This was my first time getting pimples extracted here in Chiang Mai. Tourists should learn some Northern Thai dialect! ...I didn't buy the pimple-dissolving cream the staff recommended, the one priced at 50 or 70 baht. I don't know if you'd actually get 5g if you bought it.
Very gentle hands, good advice, kind, lovely, good service and friendly.
